model_meta.system_name: One-way clutch with dog-clutch and synchronizer
model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of the disclosed vehicle automatic-transmission clutch assembly and its engagement sequence.

subsystems.description: Axially displaces the dog-clutch apply plate; the disclosed embodiment uses a hydraulically actuated piston, and other mechanisms are contemplated.

subsystems.subsystem_name: Integrated one-way, synchronizer, and dog clutch
subsystems.description: Integrated clutch structure with inner and outer races, synchronizer plate and cone, and dog-clutch apply plate and hub; friction synchronizes speeds before dog engagement.
Applies return force to the dog-clutch apply plate upon release of the clutch-apply mechanism.
External vehicle controller; the apply plate is moved in response to the controller.

item_flows.name: Axial apply displacement
item_flows.notes: Mechanism displaces apply plate into synchronizer engagement; continued displacement enables dog-clutch engagement.

item_flows.name: Rotational speed
item_flows.notes: Synchronizer cone friction retards relative rotation to synchronize the outer race and apply plate.

steps.description: The apply mechanism axially displaces the dog-clutch apply plate, engaging it with the synchronizer plate.
The synchronizer plate engages the rotating cone; friction retards relative rotation until the relevant speeds are synchronized.
Continued axial displacement completes engagement of the dog-clutch apply plate with the one-way clutch to achieve a coasting gear state.
Upon release of the clutch-apply mechanism, the return spring applies force to the apply plate.
